Katrina Zhou: Quick announcement: starting next billing cycle were introducing a dynamic surge surcharge and new concurrency cap tiers to reduce noisy peak costs and make per-request economics clearer. This is a billing-policy update (not a base price increase). :loudspeaker:

Katrina Zhou: Summary:
- Dynamic surge surcharge: short high-concurrency bursts that exceed a per-account concurrency baseline will incur a small per-token surcharge (0.5-2% sliding scale) visible as a separate invoice line item.
- Concurrency cap tiers: accounts will have default baseline concurrency (soft) depending on plan; Sales can request higher baselines for named accounts.
- Surcharge waiver window: new accounts get a 14-day waiver where surcharges are logged but not billed; existing accounts keep current behavior for 30 days.

Devon Patel: Why: a few customers have been running high fanout jobs that cause transient spike costs and SLO noise. This policy aligns cost signals with engineering behavior and reduces surprise invoices for most customers.

Mira Anwar: Rollout plan:
- Phase A (preview, next 7 days): UI/preview API shows projected surcharge exposures; feature flag billing.dynamic_surge.v1 off by default.
- Phase B (14 days): enable billing + emit invoice preview lines for one cycle (no charges).
- Phase C (30 days): surcharge charges go live for new accounts after waiver; existing accounts enter a 30-day notice window.

Katrina Zhou: Invoice notes: surcharge appears as line item "surge_surcharge" with metadata surcharge.rate and surcharge.window. Finance: please advise on accounting label. No retroactive billing.

Carlos Ruiz: Support KB short answers:
- "Will my bill jump?" -> Only if you run sustained high-concurrency bursts above your baseline. Short spikes within waiver/preview won't be billed.
- "How do I avoid surcharges?" -> Lower concurrency, use batching, or ask Sales for a higher baseline for your account.

Mira Anwar: API preview curl: 

curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \ 
  "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/billing/surcharge/preview?account_id=acct_123"

Devon Patel: Telemetry requests: billing.surge.estimated_cost_pct, billing.surge.accounts_over_baseline, billing.concurrency.baseline_by_plan. @eng-infra please add.

billing-bot: Automated: feature_flag billing.dynamic_surge.v1 created, owner=@devon, audit_id=bb-2463007890.

Katrina Zhou: Action items:
- @mira: KB + canned responses (ETA 48h)
- @devon: preview endpoint + Console card (ETA 72h)
- @finance: confirm invoice metadata and ledger mapping (ETA 48h)
- @sales: identify accounts needing elevated baselines (ETA 72h)

Mira Anwar: Will post KB draft to #support by EOD.

Katrina Zhou: We'll publish a public FAQ and in-console banner 72h before Phase B. DM me if you have major objections. Thread closed for now.
